description: A sample contract for the tests: what an order-processing application calls on its adapters. Shaped like any application's contract, so the kit's handling of kinds, payloads, sessions and destructive methods is tested without depending on a real one.

encoding.string: A string argument or result is the raw UTF-8 text, not a JSON string.
encoding.object: Any other argument or result is JSON, with property names exactly as its schema gives them.
encoding.none: A method with no argument receives an empty payload; one with no result returns an empty payload.

OrderId.description: An id a source gave in List, passed back exactly as given.

processor.description: Takes an order and says whether it was accepted.

source.description: Where orders come from, read in one session per run.
source.session: Open, List, then for each order Fetch and — once it is safely taken — Remove, and finally Close, which is also called after a failure.
